title: VTC Join-Requests Wallet Session Status — payload
description: An applicant reads the state of a wallet presentation session they opened with vtc/join-requests/wallet-session/start, and, once a wallet has answered, what the presentation established. The applicant is the document proof's signer. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

sessionId.description: The session to read, as vtc/join-requests/wallet-session/start returned it.

PresentedCredential.title: PresentedCredential
PresentedCredential.description: One credential the wallet presented, described without any of its claim values.

credentialQueryId.description: The `id` of the DCQL credential query this credential was presented for — the key it arrived under in the OpenID4VP `vp_token`.

format.description: The credential format identifier, as OpenID4VP names it (`dc+sd-jwt`, `mso_mdoc`). Carried verbatim.

issuer.description: The identifier of the credential's issuer as the community verified it — a DID, or for an issuer identified by an X.509 certificate, the certificate subject or hash the community's policy names it by.

vct.description: The SD-JWT VC credential type (`vct`). Present for SD-JWT VC credentials.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: What a verified wallet presentation established. Never claim values.

satisfied.description: Whether the presentation satisfies the criterion's DCQL query. Satisfying the query is not admission: the community still decides the join under the criterion's `admission`.

holder.description: The identifier of the key that held the presented credentials — for an SD-JWT VC, the `did:key` of its `cnf` key. Recorded beside the applicant DID, never as it.

credentials.description: The credentials presented, one entry each.

heldUntil.description: When evidence not yet recorded on a join request is discarded if the applicant has not submitted under the session's criterion. Absent when the evidence is recorded on a request.

Response.title: VTC Join-Requests Wallet Session Status — response payload

state.description: `awaitingWallet`: no wallet has fetched the request object. `requestRetrieved`: a wallet has fetched it and not yet answered. `presented`: a wallet answered and the presentation verified; see `evidence`. `refused`: a wallet answered and the community did not accept the answer, or the wallet declined; see `reason`. `expired`: the session closed unanswered.

expiresAt.description: When the session closes, or closed, if unanswered.

requestId.description: The join request the session's evidence is recorded on. Present when the session was bound to one, or its evidence has since been attached to one by a submission.

reason.description: Why the session ended `refused`. `presentationInvalid`: the response or a presentation failed verification — decryption, `state`, signature, key binding, nonce or audience. `queryNotSatisfied`: the presentations verified but do not satisfy the query. `issuerNotTrusted`: a credential's issuer is not one the criterion accepts. `statusNotValid`: a credential's status is revoked or suspended, or could not be read. `walletDeclined`: the wallet answered with an OpenID4VP error, such as `access_denied`. Present only when `state` is `refused`.
